name: Granite Backbrace
description: Settles the shield on the forearm with the elbow sprung like a bow ready to return any shock.

name: Annealed Edgeband
description: Sets the elbow at the instant of impact so the board gives a finger's width and springs back.

name: Gustcover
description: Taps the rim into the opponent's weapon hand the moment the board has sprung back from a block.

name: Racing Backboard
description: Shuffles on the back foot so the shield bounces between guard and strike without the feet stopping.

name: Heartening Shieldarm
description: Reads the heaviness of each blow through the forearm to choose how much force to return.

name: Chime Strap
description: Springs the board's face back against a cut and throws the blade up and away along the arm.

name: Bashbarrage
description: Bashes forward in the same instant the board stops a blow so both forces meet the opponent.

name: Mayhemcover
description: Pivots on the rebound so the opponent's swing carries them past and leaves their back open.

name: Adamant Bossrim
description: Gathers the force of a heavy blow in the board and returns it along the same line to the striker.

name: Mayhembuffet
description: Bursts the stored rebound outward from the board's face to hurl back every attacker standing near.

name: Unyielding Rim
description: Holds the board before the spear arm's side so the spear hand stays hidden from cuts.

name: Harrowing Face
description: Pokes the spear point over the board's upper rim at the opponent's face in one quick extension.

name: Shovespurt
description: Advances with the spear haft braced on the board's edge so both weapons travel as one.

name: Ponderous Enarme
description: Pins the opponent's sword between the spear haft and the boss and holds it fixed.

name: Enduring Enarme
description: Extends the qi field over both spear and board so neither can be cut or knocked aside.

name: Rumbleenarme
description: Lunges the spear through the gap the slanted board opens with qi concentrated in the point.

name: Rumble Ward
description: Sweeps the opponent's weapon aside with the board and returns the spear in a line behind it.

name: Glintbash
description: Thrusts the spear through the qi field with the board adding forward weight to pierce a guard.

name: Unflinching Backbrace
description: Revolves spear and board together so the field shelters the bearer from every direction at once.

name: Tempered Shoulderset
description: Draws the board back to the hip and coils the body before the heavy forward bash.

name: Steadfast Boss
description: Leans the full body weight behind the board to stop a charge before the bash is loosed.

name: Wardleap
description: Drives off the rear heel in a short charge that carries the board into the opponent's centre.

name: Tempered Cover
description: Hammers the board's face onto the opponent's raised guard to drive their arms down.

name: Enduring Rim
description: Grips the ground with the toes through each step so the heavy bash cannot be turned back.

name: Gustboss
description: Shuffles back into guard after a bash so the heavy board is never left out of position.

name: Ironward
description: Packs qi tight inside the board's centre and releases it on contact for a deeper blow.

name: Rumbleboss
description: Meets a running opponent with a bash timed to the moment their forward foot lands.

name: Drubbing Shove
description: Pushes the opponent backward with a rolling series of bashes that give no time to set.

name: Bashassault
description: Slams the whole facing into the opponent with every meridian driving the qi into the board.

name: Coverthrash
description: Drives the board through a raised guard so the impact lands on the body behind the blade.

name: Backboard Greave
description: Sinks the hips and roots both feet so the board becomes a fixed point on the ground.

name: Hardened Bossrim
description: Locks the shoulder against the board's back so no push can rotate the shield.

name: Blazeenarme
description: Chops the rim into an opponent's arm without lifting either foot from the planted stance.

name: Shoulderset Leap
description: Shifts the stance a half pace to meet a new angle without breaking the root.

name: Chime Edgeband
description: Breathes out as a blow lands so the shock spreads through the legs into the ground.

name: Charter Boss
description: Checks each foot's grip with a small stamp and corrects it before the next blow arrives.

name: Strap Plating
description: Holds the board still inside the qi field while a barrage of cuts fall on its face.

name: Resilient Face
description: Hardens the stance with qi so a pushing charge halts against the unmoving board.

name: Ironrim
description: Sends qi up from the ground through the legs into a bash that never leaves the stance.

name: Ponderous Bash
description: Pins the opponent's weapon against the ground with the rooted board and holds it by qi.

name: Aegis Shieldarm
description: Spreads the qi field through the body so even a siege-weight blow dies in the planted bearer.

name: Annealed Bossrim
description: Stands unmoved as a blow lands and returns its force through the board in a single shove.

name: Shieldarm Plating
description: Raises the shield so the rim meets the opponent's blade rather than the flat of the board.

name: Facecloak
description: Catches a blade on the rim and twists the shield to pull the weapon out of the opponent's hand.

name: Trouncing Cover
description: Cuts back along the arc of the guard with the sharpened rim into the opponent's forearm.

name: Coversprint
description: Slides forward with the rim leading to take the opponent's cut on the metal edge.

name: Rimtorment
description: Whets the rim with qi and drags it across the opponent's guard to open the arm beneath.

name: Unshaken Backbrace
description: Crosses the rim over the blade's path and catches it at the edge to throw it out wide.

name: Unshaken Charter Edgeband
description: Beats the rim against the opponent's qi-laden cut at its weak point and undoes the technique.

name: Iron Buffet
description: Cuts with the rim and drives with the boss in a single turn of the shield arm.

name: Boss Plating
description: Sets the board beside a partner's so the two shields cover one another's open side.

name: Granite Shove
description: Moves in an echoing step beside the partner so the two boards advance as one pair.

name: Splitting Bash
description: Jabs the rim along one track while the partner's shield guards the second track.

name: Heartening Rim
description: Taps the board's rim against the partner's in a count that tells where the next gap will open.

name: Hardened Face
description: Crosses both boards across the shared front to meet a charge that threatens either partner.

name: Enarme Cloak
description: Links two bearers by a thread of qi so a blow on one board is felt and braced by both.

name: Rimcloak
description: Closes both rims on the opponent's weapon like scissors and locks it between the two shields.

name: Siltenarme
description: Sweeps both boards outward on two tracks to drive every nearby attacker back from the pair.

name: Doctrine Shieldarm
description: Holds the two boards at fixed angles in a court of two that shelters ground between the shields.

name: Strap Cuirass
description: Opens the arms wide with the shield held out like a hawk's wing to widen the cover.

name: Mantled Enarme
description: Folds the open guard back to the chest in one motion as a strike arrives from the side.

name: Silt Ward
description: Drops down and forward in a swooping step with the board angled over the head and body.

name: Mightstrap
description: Strikes down with the rim like a talon at the opponent's wrist as the wing opens.

name: Sustaining Edgeband
description: Reads the opponent's balance through the shield's tremor as the guard opens and folds in rhythm.

name: Backbrace Linctus
description: Marks the gap in the opponent's guard from the corner of the eye as the wing sweeps wide.

name: Bossrim Cloak
description: Spreads the guard to catch a cut far out and throws it wide of the body.

name: Gyve Buffet
description: Snaps the open wing shut across the opponent's arm and traps it between board and body.

name: Tempered Backboard
description: Swoops the board down from above with qi flaring in the arm to land on the opponent's guard.

name: Slag Cover
description: Opens the wing fully with qi surging along the rim to sweep back those pressing close.

name: Facet Backboard
description: Folds the field around the bearer like wings closing so volleys of blows cannot reach through.

name: Granite Face
description: Stands with the board slanted and the body bent like a river curve so blows slide past.

name: Implacable Strap
description: Plants the board like a stone in a stream so a charge breaks to either side.

name: Might Shoulderset
description: Steps aside with the flow of the opponent's momentum and lets the board follow.

name: Suppressing Shove
description: Hooks the rim around the opponent's forearm and turns it in a small eddy.

name: Fortifying Backbrace
description: Reads the line of the opponent's weight like the surface of moving water before committing.

name: Steadfast Backboard
description: Bends the board around a heavy cut so it flows along the face and past the bearer.

name: Buffet Onslaught
description: Shoves the shoulder into the opponent in the direction their own force is already carrying them.

name: Dominating Buffet
description: Spins the board in a whirlpool motion that drags the opponent's weapon off its line.

name: Waning Rim
description: Lets a blow run round the board and sends the full force back on the same current.

name: Wrecking Cover
description: Presses forward behind the board like a rising flood with qi that grows steadily heavier.

name: Unflinching Rim
description: Takes a wide stance at the lip of the guarded ground with the board facing out.

name: Unshaken Boss
description: Leans the board inward toward the centre so its shadow covers the partner behind it.

name: Strap Jaunt
description: Walks the rim of the hollow with the board outward so no blow reaches the centre.

name: Buffetassault
description: Strikes along the edge of the guarded ground to knock back anyone who reaches for the hollow.

name: Chime Shieldarm
description: Taps the board to tell the partner in the hollow which side is being pressed.

name: Hoarfrost Edgeband
description: Braces the shoulder against the partner's back so the pair's boards act as one.

name: Annealed Face
description: Angles the board to funnel a cut toward the hollow's edge where a partner's rim waits.

name: Might Bossrim
description: Pools qi in the ground of the hollow so the partners' boards stay steady against heavy blows.

name: Annealed Boss
description: Raises both boards in a brim over the hollow to shelter it from falling missiles.

name: Steadfast Enarme
description: Presses both boards against an incoming technique at its weak pattern and cancels it inside the hollow.

name: Noxious Shieldarm
description: Holds the partnered shields at the lip of the hollow in a formation that dulls any attack on the centre.

name: Slagrim
description: Releases the gathered force of the hollow outward through the rims to hurl attackers back.

name: Backbrace Cloak
description: Faces the advancing enemy with the board turned into them as into a hard wind.

name: Boss Cuirass
description: Holds the board where it was first raised and lets no blow move it from the line.

name: Coverpounce
description: Steps forward in a quick gust behind the board and lands with the rim already ready.

name: Chime Bossrim
description: Glances at a fixed mark on the ground to confirm the facing has not drifted.

name: Chime Backboard
description: Cuts the board across the line of attack like a blade of wind and sweeps the blow aside.

name: Buffetthrash
description: Shoves with the board while keeping the stance so the oath to hold the line is not broken.

name: Steadfast Edgeband
description: Braces against a storm of blows with qi in every limb so the board stays level to the end.

name: Immovable Strap
description: Takes the wind of an attack on the board and hurls the force back in one open-handed bash.

name: Hoarfrost Enarme
description: Plants the board at the sworn place and swears silently that it will not move from it.

name: Rim Greave
description: Locks the forearm so the board holds through pain and fatigue without a lowering of the rim.

name: Hastening Bash
description: Steps along the line with a wide footing as on the edge of a high plateau.

name: Coverbarrage
description: Raps the rim hard against an opponent's guard to drive them back from the sworn line.

name: Rousing Boss
description: Calls a short word to the neighbouring bearer so each knows the other still holds.

name: Aegis Backbrace
description: Spreads the field out to the neighbours on either side so they stand within the same cover.

name: Unbroken Shieldarm
description: Drives qi into the legs at the oath's keeping and stops a charge at the sworn mark.

name: Facetorment
description: Heaves the board forward from the held line then returns to the line before the next blow.

name: Mayhem Bash
description: Hooks the rim round an opponent who pushes through the line and drags them to a stop.

name: Unflinching Enarme
description: Spreads the oath's qi field along the line so no single bearer's board can be broken alone.

name: Ravaging Bash Torment
description: Surges the whole oath line forward a pace with qi flowing between boards to drive the enemy back.

name: Unbroken Bossrim
description: Sets the board low and wide on bare ground where no cover stands except the shield.

name: Steadfast Strap
description: Leans into the board against a rising wind that carries dust and thrown stones.

name: Siltbash
description: Sidesteps on open ground with the board turned to cover the exposed flank.

name: Mindful Rim
description: Studies the horizon for riders and archers over the rim while the board holds the front.

name: Wardthrash
description: Chops the rim down onto an opponent who closes in across the bare ground.

name: Equipoise Face
description: Slants the board against a rider's thrust so the lance slides up and past the bearer.

name: Hoarfrost Backboard
description: Sinks qi through the soles and holds a bearing on the open plateau against every push.

name: Staggering Shoulderset
description: Kicks up dust behind the board's edge as a screen and steps out of the opponent's sight.

name: Mayhem Shoulderset
description: Sweeps the board in a flat low arc that clears those closing in from several sides.

name: Implacable Face
description: Holds a lone ground against many with qi in the board to endure blows from every direction.

name: Enduring Edgeband
description: Holds the board in a half-open turn so each cut that arrives is already sliding aside.

name: Bounding Shoulderset
description: Steps toward the blow's origin so the board meets it before it has gathered force.

name: Bashthrash
description: Flicks the rim at the opponent's eyes in a swift gust to break the rhythm of the attack.

name: Rim Tincture
description: Times the turn of the board to the rhythm of the breath so the guard never stalls.

name: Resilient Backboard
description: Wheels the board in a whirlwind with qi pulsing in the arm to turn a flurry of cuts.

name: Rimassault
description: Shoves in the instant between two blows as the gust of the opponent's attack passes.

name: Toxinstrap
description: Scatters the opponent's rhythm with a short board beat that lands between their swings.

name: Annealed Backbrace
description: Spins the board against the pattern of a technique and breaks its qi apart like wind scattering smoke.

name: Glint Strap
description: Turns the whole storm of an attack on the board and sends it back at the attacker.
